modules.name: BellMaul
modules.usage: Bell-Breaker maul: ash haft (grip centre at origin), a cracked bronze bell as the head with the mouth toward +X and an iron spike toward -X at y=1.06. Emission = the ember clapper in the mouth.

modules.name: PendulumRapier
modules.usage: Clockmaker's rapier: needle blade +Y to y=1.12, brass cup guard with a gear disc facing the camera, S quillons, knuckle bow on +X, pendulum charm under the pommel. Emission = gear gem + pendulum glass.

modules.name: TideScythe
modules.usage: Tide scythe: driftwood snath (grip at origin, y=-0.6..1.1), crescent blade from the top toward +X curving down to (0.78, 0.76), edge on the inner side; kelp strips, side nib on -X. Emission = sea-glass line along the blade spine.

modules.name: ChainFlail
modules.usage: Chain flail: dark-wood handle (grip at origin, y=-0.19..0.24), interlocked chain arcing to a spiked iron ball centred at (0.19, 0.62). Emission = molten windows on both ball faces.

modules.name: GraveShovel
modules.usage: Gravedigger's shovel: ash shaft (grip at origin, y=-0.6..0.86), D-handle at the bottom, pointed spade y=0.84..1.2 facing the camera (+-Z). Emission = three embedded star chips.

modules.name: Crossbow
modules.usage: Fishbone crossbow (Bow mount convention): pistol grip at origin, stock along Y with the butt at +Y, bone prod with limbs along +-Z at y=-0.34, a bolt loaded toward -Y. Emission = glass sight.
